name: Hesperian-Machair
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait bioluminescent seas, and everything the light never reaches.

The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
Around the spatial rift remnant, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
